GCS has been Rayo's sleeve sponsor since the club announcement of 15 September 2023 (rayovallecano.es/noticias/gcs-nuevo-patrocinado-del-rayo-vallecano): 'Este nuevo patrocinador tendrá presencia en la manga de la equipación de juego del primer equipo masculino, femenino y del filial.'

source.note: Kit-sponsor table row: Umbro makes the 2026/27 Rayo Vallecano shirt (kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention).

summary: Digi on the front, GCS on the sleeve, Umbro as kit maker (Score and Change's shirt, sleeve and kit tables). The article has no per-club back-of-shirt or shorts table: its text says 15 clubs have a back sponsor and names Digi only as Athletic's, without saying whether Rayo has one, so no cited source confirms Rayo's back and shorts are unsponsored.
